title: headless-run config
description: Engines for headless-run: %APPDATA%\headless-run\config.json, %ProgramData%\headless-run\config.json, or a file passed with --config.

engine.description: Engines by name. A key set here replaces the same key of a lower layer (built-in, then system, then global, then --config).

path.description: The interpreter: a file name searched on PATH (.exe is added when it has no extension), or a path. %NAME% expands from the child's environment. An array lists candidates, and the first that exists wins.

arguments.description: Arguments placed between the interpreter and the program, such as ["-NoProfile", "-File"].

extensions.description: The extensions --engine accepts without --force-engine, such as [".py", ".pyw"].

quoteCommand.description: Wrap the program and its arguments in one outer quote pair, as cmd.exe /s /c needs.

extension.description: The engine each extension runs under when no --engine is given, by extension without its dot, such as {"py": "python"}.
